newsitem.title: USA: Supertyphoon threatens shipping in Pacific - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Supertyphoon threatens shipping in Pacific - WSC.

text.p: Supertyphoon Nestor is in the northern Mariana Islands with top winds of 155 mph, and is expected to near Iwo Jima in about 36 hours with only slight weakening expected, independent forecaster Weather Services Corporation (WSC) said.
The system is an extreme danger to the islands and to shipping in the region.
Seas of over 20 feet can be expected, along with extreme winds and torrential rainfall.
